description: Session 10 golden set for retrieval evaluation. Fifteen representative project descriptions to estimate, each hand-annotated with the historical budgets that are genuinely relevant. Graded over the BASE corpus (data/budgets_sample.json, chunk_type='budget_component') so the score is reproducible even if the task corpus is also ingested. A retrieved chunk counts as relevant iff its parent budget_id is in relevant_budget_ids; because precision@5 is chunk-level and the top-5 is never truncated, the max score of a query is min(relevant_chunks, 5)/5 (a single 3-component budget caps at 0.6, a 4-component at 0.8, two+ budgets reach 1.0). The distractors are deliberately cross-sector 'similar but irrelevant' budgets (e.g. e-commerce vendor payouts vs. a fintech payments gateway, or industrial sensor telemetry vs. wearable ingestion) — the exact failure mode this exercise attacks. Query text is English on purpose: the corpus content is English and the FTS column uses to_tsvector('spanish', content), so English queries keep the lexical branch meaningful; Spanish queries would zero it out and collapse the hybrid configs onto the vector ones.

queries.query: Mobile banking application with OAuth2 authentication, PSD2 open banking compliance, strong customer authentication and a transaction ledger.
queries.note: Fintech auth + payments. Trap: BUD-2024-006 (e-commerce marketplace vendor payouts) is 'payments-like' but irrelevant for a banking auth project.

queries.query: Headless e-commerce storefront with a product catalog, shopping cart checkout and personalized product recommendations.
queries.note: E-commerce storefront/catalog/checkout. Trap: finance payment budgets (BUD-2024-003) and healthcare scheduling are close in topic words but wrong domain.

queries.query: Telemedicine platform for patient appointment scheduling and video consultations with HL7/FHIR integration and clinical records.
queries.note: Healthcare telemedicine. Trap: BUD-2024-011 (pharmacy inventory) and BUD-2024-012 (clinical trials) share the healthcare sector but cover different functionality.

queries.query: Industrial IoT platform ingesting sensor telemetry for predictive maintenance and real-time equipment monitoring in a factory.
queries.note: Industrial telemetry/monitoring. Trap: BUD-2024-014 (warehouse AGV coordination) is industrial but logistics, not telemetry-driven maintenance.

queries.query: Real-time payments gateway with fraud detection, transaction reconciliation and a double-entry ledger.
queries.note: Fintech payments. Trap: BUD-2024-006 (e-commerce vendor payouts) and BUD-2024-007 (grocery delivery payments) are lexically near but wrong domain.

queries.query: Consumer lending platform with automated loan origination, credit scoring from bureau data and bank statements, KYC underwriting and e-signature loan contracts.
queries.note: Consumer lending. Only BUD-2024-002 genuinely matches (loan origination + scoring); ceiling 0.8 (4 components). Trap: BUD-2024-001/003 are finance but banking/payments, not lending.

queries.query: Robo-advisor wealth management platform with automated portfolio rebalancing, mean-variance optimization and end-of-day market data ingestion.
queries.note: Wealth/robo-advisor. Only BUD-2024-004 matches; ceiling 0.6 (3 components). Trap: BUD-2024-001/003 (finance) share vocabulary but are banking/payments.

queries.query: Pharmacy management system with electronic prescription intake, drug-interaction checks, lot-and-expiry inventory and dispensing labels.
queries.note: Pharmacy operations. Only BUD-2024-011 matches; ceiling 0.6 (3 components). Trap: BUD-2024-009/012 share the healthcare sector; BUD-2024-014 shares 'inventory/reorder' vocabulary but is warehouse logistics.

queries.query: Clinical trial data platform with configurable electronic data capture forms, patient de-identification and CDISC-aligned regulatory dataset export.
queries.note: Clinical trial data capture. Only BUD-2024-012 matches; ceiling 0.6 (3 components). Trap: BUD-2024-009 (healthcare records) is close in sector; BUD-2024-002/016 share 'regulatory export' vocabulary.

queries.query: Fashion e-commerce returns and resale portal with self-service return labels, warehouse item grading and secondary-market listing sync.
queries.note: Fashion returns/resale. Only BUD-2024-008 matches; ceiling 0.6 (3 components). Trap: BUD-2024-005/006/017 are same-sector e-commerce but storefront/marketplace, not returns.

queries.query: Healthcare platform handling protected health information: clinical records with HL7/FHIR, patient consent capture, immutable access audit and data de-identification.
queries.note: PHI handling across records + privacy. BUD-2024-009 (FHIR records + consent/audit) and BUD-2024-012 (de-identification + data capture) both genuinely handle PHI; ceiling 1.0. Trap: BUD-2024-010/011 share the healthcare sector but cover monitoring/pharmacy.

queries.query: Logistics automation for warehouse and last-mile delivery: inventory picking, automated guided vehicle coordination and delivery route optimization.
queries.note: Logistics/routing across warehouse + delivery. BUD-2024-014 (WMS + AGV) and BUD-2024-007 (delivery slots + route optimization) are functionally logistics; ceiling 1.0. Trap: BUD-2024-013 is industrial IoT (telemetry/maintenance), not logistics.

queries.query: Multi-vendor marketplace with vendor onboarding and KYC, split-order fulfillment, scheduled vendor payouts and buyer-seller dispute handling.
queries.note: Marketplace operations. Only BUD-2024-006 matches; ceiling 0.8 (4 components). Trap: BUD-2024-003 shares 'payouts/reconciliation' vocabulary but is a payments gateway; BUD-2024-005/017 are e-commerce but single-vendor storefront.

queries.query: Remote patient monitoring with wearable vital-sign ingestion, threshold-based clinical alerting on abnormal trends and a care-team triage dashboard.
queries.note: Remote patient monitoring. Only BUD-2024-010 matches; ceiling 0.6 (3 components). Trap: BUD-2024-013 ('sensor telemetry ingestion') is a strong cross-sector lexical trap (industrial, not clinical); BUD-2024-009 shares the healthcare sector.

queries.query: Core banking modernization: event-sourced double-entry transaction ledger, idempotent postings, settlement reconciliation and strangler-fig migration off the legacy monolith.
queries.note: Core banking ledger/reconciliation/migration. BUD-2024-016 (monolith decomposition + event-sourced ledger), BUD-2024-001 (transaction ledger) and BUD-2024-003 (settlement reconciliation) all genuinely match; ceiling 1.0 and folds 016 into a paired query (016 alone would cap at 0.4). Trap: BUD-2024-006 shares 'reconciliation' vocabulary but is a marketplace.
